native.scope: Original native C++ recipe, descriptor/buffer getter interfaces and actual memory implementation compiled independently; not final kernel or device/physical provenance.

limits: NativeAdrenoMemory host implementation uses existing IOKit/cache doubles, not real kernel PA/cache/DMA/SMMU evidence.
Descriptor role binding does not map/power/authorize broad apertures; masks retain overlaps.
Snapshot uses held external stable lease assertions, not a generic concurrent publisher; callers retain objects on failure.
No clock/power/PAS/SCM/SMMU programming, GPU start, automatic IOService attachment, new kernel or phone operation.
All runtime config providers remain explicitly missing; no fake runnable Sheng config.
findings: Cached node unit-address gmu@3d69000 is a name, while its actual named gmu reg starts0x3d68000, size0x37000. Generated profile uses reg, not node unit-address.
GMU overlaps CX-misc by0x1000. AO [0x3d40000,0x3d50000) is adjacent to RSCC, not overlapping. Resource descriptions do not establish safe access windows.
NativeAdrenoGmuAllocator has five hardcoded buffers/IOVAs; reuse actual generic NativeAdrenoMemory backing provider for a separate fixed-capacity Gen7 memory set, not the old allocator.
initial_failures: Existing host memory fixture lacked IODirection/kIOMemoryPersistent required by current common memory code. Host-only aliases/constant added using exact frozen header; no production/header change.

First test assumed reg base from node name and AO/RSCC overlap; assertions rejected. Corrected test to actual cached reg and exclusive-end intervals. Generated profile was already correct; no phone driver fix.

next_action: Implement a fixed-capacity owned Gen7 static memory set using actual NativeAdrenoMemory allocation and the fixed-SHA firmware plan; prepare8CPU-owned backings once under a caller-held gate, retain every partial/quarantined outcome, and perform no GPU/SMMU/firmware operation.
